name: Wenikee Boltbucket
summary: Near the Mor'shan Rampart, Wenikee Boltbucket may be able to mend a broken samophlange. Sputtervalve tinkered with the device after it was retrieved from the Sludge Fen, and now needs an expert hand before his colleagues in Undermine demand results.

sections.title: A Delicate Mishap
sections.body: Sputtervalve's claims to his fellow engineers in Undermine now hang on a broken machine. An adventurer retrieved the mysterious samophlange from the Venture Company's control console at the Sludge Fen, and Sputtervalve could not resist showing it off. His tinkering damaged the delicate contraption. He needs someone with sharper skill to diagnose the damage and repair it.

sections.title: The Tinkerer by the Rampart
sections.body: Wenikee Boltbucket camps beside the road just south of the Mor'shan Rampart. The rampart divides the northern Barrens from Ashenvale. Her inquisitive mind is drawn to intricate machinery, and the broken samophlange quickly captures her attention. Its internal gears hold her curiosity, and she sets to work figuring out how to rebuild it.

faq.answer: Sputtervalve damaged the samophlange while examining and tinkering with it after it was recovered from the Sludge Fen control console.

Wenikee Boltbucket is an inventive goblin tinkerer camped just south of the Mor'shan Rampart, on the border between the northern Barrens and Ashenvale. She is known for her skill with complex machinery.

faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve care so much about fixing it?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve bragged to his colleagues in Undermine that he had secured the device. If he cannot deliver a working samophlange, his reputation and professional standing will suffer.

faq.q: Does Wenikee know what a samophlange actually does?
aliases: does she know what it is
what is a samophlange to her
faq.answer: No. When Wenikee first sees the samophlange, she asks what it is. Its intricate gears fascinate her, and she wants to repair it to see what it does.

faq.q: Where is the Mor'shan Rampart located?
faq.answer: The Mor'shan Rampart is a fortified Horde outpost on the northern edge of the Barrens, guarding the pass into Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happens after Wenikee examines the broken device?
faq.answer: Wenikee agrees to repair the samophlange, intrigued by its construction. She needs specific mechanical parts, beginning with nugget slugs kept in Venture Company tool buckets at the Sludge Fen, to get the gears working again.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can understand why the samophlange stirs such curiosity. Neither Sputtervalve nor Wenikee knows its original purpose, but its complex gears invite investigation.

As a member of the Horde, you know Wenikee's camp lies in the shadow of the Mor'shan Rampart, a fortified choke point protecting Horde territory in the northern Barrens from incursions out of Ashenvale.
